title: National Guard Memorial Museum

services.name: Schedule a Tour
services.desc: Groups of five or more can fill out the form below to request a guided tour. Once we receive your information, we will contact you to confirm a tour date and time. Groups of less than five and individuals are welcome to self-guide through the museum. Depending on staff availability, we will greet you before your self-guided tour to introduce the museum. For guided tour requests, please allow at least 24 hours notice to ensure museum staff availability. There are many ways you can support NGEF’s efforts! blurb: The National Guard Memorial Museum is the first and only national museum dedicated to telling the story of the National Guard. First opened as the National Guard Heritage Gallery in 1976 in time for America’s bicentennial celebration, the museum originally explored the origins of the Guard through a series of artifacts and dioramas.
